verdict.rationale: ClickHouse publishes an official MCP server in its own GitHub org (ClickHouse/mcp-clickhouse), which connects ClickHouse to AI assistants. A first-party docs guide explains choosing an MCP client or framework to connect an agent. missing for 10: documented tool list and server capabilities, setup and authentication details, independent hands-on corroboration of agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect ClickHouse to your AI assistants.
Choose an MCP client or framework to connect an AI assistant to ClickHouse.
